dogecoin.text: What happened with $Doge during SNL made me realize that there can be no guarantee that coin(s) will pump or dip at any particular point. Many speculated that it would pump during the show, maybe even reach $1. I was hoping to sell mine immediately after the show.
@Kapitan_Joey Truly it was top drawer, but people only focus on where their interest lies. A lot of people are interested in Dogecoin.
